verdict.rationale: Interview preparation is a fair axis for an ATS like Workable, but the evidence pack never mentions interview kits, scorecards attached to calendar invites, calendar integration, or automated feedback reminders. The candidate rating API endpoint is only a developer building block for recording evaluations, not automated interviewer preparation, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a hiring manager, interviewers get prepared automatically — calendar invites carry the interview kit, the scorecard, and reminders to submit feedback
